issues.summary: Workspace loading guard `isQualifiedSafe && spaceSafesLoading` can never be true, and its test mocks an impossible state
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: useIsQualifiedSafe.ts only returns true once `currentData` of useSpaceSafesGetV1Query (same args/skip as in useSpaceSafes.tsx) exists, and at that point RTK's `isLoading` is false. That makes useAccountsModalItems.ts:139 dead, and the test at useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:87-95 checks a state that can't happen. While loading, the modal really shows 'All Accounts' unfiltered and then switches, so the flash the PR says it fixes is still there.

issues.summary: Similarity check runs on the list after workspace safes are removed, so lookalikes of workspace safes go unflagged
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:102 computes getFlaggedSimilarAddressSet over allItems, which is built from filteredAllSafes (line 89-94). Before the PR the modal included workspace safes in this check. The PR calls this a v1 limitation, but it still weakens address-poisoning detection in workspace context.

issues.summary: Hook tests never assert on similarAddresses
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: No test in useAccountsModalItems.test.ts checks `similarAddresses`, although the set it's computed over changed (now the filtered list). A regression in this security-related output would go unnoticed.

issues.summary: Owned-safes error notification effect and debounced search analytics in the hook are untested
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: The test mocks useOwnersGetAllSafesByOwnerV2Query to always return `error: undefined` (useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:30-32), and nothing asserts trackEvent or dispatch. The code moved over unchanged from the old index.tsx, which had no tests for it either.

issues.summary: useSpaceSafes returns a new allSafes array every render, so the exclusion/filter/group/similarity chain recomputes every render
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useSpaceSafes.tsx builds `safeItems` without memoization, so useAllSafesGrouped's memo and then allSafes change on every render. spaceExclusionKey (useAccountsModalItems.ts:71-74) and everything after it recompute even when the modal is closed, because the hook runs before `if (!open)`. It's a real performance cost but a small one.

issues.summary: The 40-line docblock is long, and one line wrongly says callers render the retry notification
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:57-58 says errors are surfaced 'so callers can render a retry notification', but the hook dispatches showNotification itself (lines 76-87). The claim that the docblock is out of date on similarity is wrong (that part is accurate). The length is a style concern.

issues.summary: Comment says search analytics fires once per non-empty query; the code fires once until the search is cleared
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:117-130: `searchTracked` resets only when the search is empty, so typing 'a'→'ab'→'abc' fires one event. The behaviour predates the PR; only the misleading comment is new.

issues.summary: arrayContaining(['1111','1111']) passes even if only one group is bolded
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: MultiSafeItemCard.test.tsx:123: arrayContaining doesn't count duplicates, and with an all-1s address it can't tell the first group from the last. The test would pass if only one <b> rendered.

issues.summary: Loading-skeleton test only asserts that other content is absent
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: index.test.tsx:118-125 checks only that the empty state and card mocks are absent. It would still pass if the list rendered nothing at all.

issues.summary: 'All Accounts' is Title Case, against the sentence-case convention
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The string at AccountsModal/index.tsx:42 and SpaceSafeBar/index.tsx:176 already existed before the PR and matches the neighbouring pre-existing headings ('Trusted Safes', 'Other Safes'). It is a convention mismatch with no functional cost.

issues.summary: Duplicated section/card render JSX in AccountsModal
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: AccountsModal/index.tsx:77-133 repeats almost the same blocks, and the PR adds hidePinControls to all four branches. Extracting a helper would be cleaner, but the duplication was already there and has no concrete cost.

issues.summary: Both modal modes send the same analytics events and labels
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:126 and index.tsx:144/162 use the same events in both contexts. Whether the funnels need to be told apart is a product decision, not a defect.

issues.summary: The isSimilar bold branch has no length guard, unlike TooltipFullAddress
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: shared.tsx:158-164 slices without the check used at line 121. Callers always pass full 0x addresses, so it's only an inconsistency.

issues.summary: New tests hand-roll a safeItem factory instead of using the existing safeItemBuilder
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: apps/web/src/tests/builders/safeItem.ts exists. The inline factories in index.test.tsx:48 and useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:43 duplicate it, which matters only for test maintenance.

issues.summary: `filteredAllSafes ?? []` creates a new array each render while loading
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:94: the new [] appears only while allSafes is undefined, and grouping an empty array costs almost nothing. isLoading is true in that state anyway.

issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:21-22 uses _getMultiChainAccounts/_getSingleChainAccounts. Production code already relies on this export convention (e.g. _buildSafeItems in useSpaceSafes.tsx), so it adds no new fragility.

issues.summary: Early return keys off a null spaceExclusionKey rather than isQualifiedSafe
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.ts:90: spaceExclusionKey is null exactly when !isQualifiedSafe (line 72), and an empty Set would filter nothing anyway. The concern is only about readability.

issues.summary: Multi-chain partial-workspace degrade path is said to be untested
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useAccountsModalItems.test.ts:107-119 puts ADDR_A on chains 1 and 100, excludes chain 1, and asserts `100:ADDR_A` using `(item as SafeItem).chainId`. That assertion would fail if the item were still a MultiChainSafeItem (it has no chainId), so the degrade path is covered.
